description: Common acids used in rare earth solvent extraction

HNO3.name: Nitric acid
HNO3.notes: Most common acid in REE separation; forms extractable Ln(NO3)3 complexes

H2SO4.name: Sulfuric acid
H2SO4.notes: Used in some extraction systems; sulfate complexation can affect selectivity

HCl.name: Hydrochloric acid
HCl.notes: Less common for extraction; used primarily for stripping/back-extraction

HClO4.name: Perchloric acid
HClO4.notes: Non-complexing acid; used to study pure solvation extraction

notes: Acid concentration typically ranges from 0.1 to 8 M in REE extraction studies. Counterion choice significantly affects extraction mechanism and selectivity.
